name: Beware the Crystals Awakening: Romantic Intervention
source:
The bandits want the king to loose his power over the land. To make him lay down his crown, they infiltrate the castle to kidnap the beloved princess. Luckily, her guard is quick enough to get her out!

With the princess gone, they found something of similiar value in the castle vaults. Now she has a limit of 5 days to prevent a big tragedy from coming upon her people.

[From [url=https://alinalinaa.itch.io/beware-the-crystals-awakening-romantic-intervention]itch.io[/url]]
